model.title: Rural Jobs and Hydropower Expansion Act
model.meta: Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Lauren Boebert (R-CO)

summary.text: The bill would amend a 1939 federal water law so that hydropower, meaning electricity generated from flowing water, could be produced at all Bureau of Reclamation facilities rather than only certain small conduit and pumped storage sites. It would update the terms used for facilities that are transferred to or kept by the federal government, and would keep existing hydropower licenses from the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission in place until they become inactive. It would also state that the law does not expand the bureau's power lease authority outside a project's boundary.
